Plugin.Name: bongIT Theme
Plugin.Overview:
A calm light and dark theme for the Unraid webGUI in the bongIT house style (petrol, paper, red). CSS only, no services or binaries: it appends its stylesheets to Unraid's Black and White themes and restores them on removal.
- Light and dark follow Unraid's colour scheme (White / Black); each browser can switch with the sun/moon button in the toolbar without changing the server setting. - Header with a circuit-board pattern or your own banner images (light and dark), bongIT logo instead of the Unraid wordmark, tidy dashboard tiles, dialogs, tables and plugin pages. - Settings page (Settings → bongIT Theme) in German.
Requires Unraid 7.4.1 or newer. Based on Aether Glass by aegisnir (MIT).
